text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Jalan Persekutuan

(Skim Felda) (Pindaan) 2021.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 30 Julai 2021.

Pindaan Jadual Pertama

2. Perintah Jalan Persekutuan (Skim Felda) 1991 [P.U. (A) 449/1991], yang disebut

"Perintah ibu" dalam Perintah ini, dipinda dalam Jadual Pertama di bawah kepala

Negeri Pahang—

(a) berhubung dengan butiran "Jalan Utama Mempaga", dalam ruang

"Jalan Masuk (km)", dengan menggantikan perkataan "32.00" dengan

perkataan "17.554"; dan

(b) dengan memasukkan selepas butiran "Terapai–Mayam" dan butir-butir

yang berhubungan dengannya butiran dan butir-butir yang berikut:

JADUAL PERTAMA

NEGERI PAHANG

Nama Skim

FELDA

Nombor Laluan

Bagi Jalan Masuk

Jalan Masuk

(km)

Jalan Kampung

(km)

"Jalan Mempaga

Bentong

1584 16.804 —".

Pindaan Jadual Kedua

3. Jadual Kedua kepada Perintah ibu dipinda dengan memasukkan selepas PETA 2:

JALAN FELDA NITAR TIMUR peta-peta yang berikut:

"JADUAL KEDUA

PETA 3: JALAN UTAMA MEMPAGA

PETA 4: JALAN MEMPAGA BENTONG

 ."

Dibuat 27 Julai 2021

[KKR.PUU.110-1/6/7Jld.2; PN(PU2)391/Jld. 40]

DATO' SRI HAJI FADILLAH BIN HAJI YUSOF

Menteri Kanan Kerja Raya

[Akan dibentangkan di Dewan Rakyat menurut seksyen 4 Akta Jalan Persekutuan 1959]

FEDERAL ROADS ACT 1959

FEDERAL ROADS (FELDA SCHEME) (AMENDMENT) ORDER 2021

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 3 of the Federal Roads Act 1959 [Act 376],

the Minister, after consultation with the State Government of Pahang, makes the

following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (Felda Scheme)

(Amendment) Order 2021.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 30 July 2021.

Amendment of First Schedule

2. The Federal Roads (Felda Scheme) Order 1991 [P.U. (A) 449/1991], which is

referred to as "principal Order" in this Order, is amended in the First Schedule under the

heading of State of Pahang—

(a) in relation to item "Jalan Utama Mempaga", in column "Approach Roads

(km)", by substituting for the word "32.00" the word "17.554"; and

(b) by inserting after item "Terapai–Mayam" and the particulars relating to it

the following item and the particulars relating to it:

FIRST SCHEDULE

NEGERI PAHANG

Name of FELDA

Scheme

Route Number

for Approach

Roads

Approach

Roads

(km)

Village Roads

(km)

"Mempaga

Bentong Road

1584 16.804 —".

Amendment of Second Schedule

3. The Second Schedule to the principal Order is amended by inserting after

MAP 2: FELDA NITAR TIMUR ROAD the following maps:

"SECOND SCHEDULE

MAP 3: MEMPAGA MAIN ROAD

MAP 4: MEMPAGA BENTONG ROAD

Made 27 July 2021

[KKR.PUU.110-1/6/7Jld.2; PN(PU2)391/Jld. 40]

 DATO' SRI HAJI FADILLAH BIN HAJI YUSOF

 Senior Minister of Works

[To be laid before the Dewan Rakyat pursuant to section 4 of the Federal Roads Act 1959]

."
